method: breaths by loudness (under -16 dB for 0.2 s, phrases under 1.5 s merged) + text alignment; Whisper: 27 of 36 breaks heard

lines.english: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above,
and let the clouds rain down the Just One.
Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above,
and let the clouds rain down the Just One.
Be not angry, O Lord,
remember iniquity no longer:

lines.latin: ecce cívitas Sancti facta est desérta: Sion desérta facta est:
lines.english: behold, the city of the Holy One is become a desert: Sion is become a desert:
Jerusalem is desolate:

lines.latin: domus sanctificatiónis tuæ et glóriæ tuæ,
lines.english: the house of Thy sanctification and of Thy glory,
where our fathers praised Thee.
Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above,
and let the clouds rain down the Just One.

lines.latin: Peccávimus, et facti sumus tamquam immúndus nos,
lines.english: We have sinned, and are become as one unclean,
and we have fallen
like a leaf, every one of us:

lines.latin: et iniquitátes nostræ quasi ventus abstulérunt nos:
lines.english: and our iniquities, like the wind, have carried us away:
Thou hast hidden Thy face from us,

lines.latin: et allisísti nos in manu iniquitátis nostræ.
lines.english: and hast crushed us in the hand of our iniquity.
Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above,
and let the clouds rain down the Just One.
Behold, O Lord, the affliction of Thy people,
and send forth Him Whom Thou art to send:
send forth the Lamb, the ruler of the earth,

lines.latin: de Petra desérti ad montem fíliæ Sion:
lines.english: from the Rock of the desert to the mount of the daughter of Sion:

lines.latin: ut áuferat ipse jugum captivitátis nostræ.
lines.english: that He Himself may take away the yoke of our captivity.
Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above,
and let the clouds rain down the Just One.
Be comforted,
be comforted, My people:
thy salvation shall quickly come:
why art thou wasted with grief,
because sorrow hath come upon thee anew?
I will save thee, fear not,

lines.latin: ego enim sum Dóminus Deus tuus,
lines.english: for I am the Lord thy God,
the Holy One of Israel, thy Redeemer.
Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above,
and let the clouds rain down the Just One.
